question: The Ministry of Environment and Forest launched Vahini Scheme in ______ with the basic objective of encouraging people's participation in environmental protection. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: June 1992
July 1994
June 1988
July 1990
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is June 1992

Explanation:
The Ministry of Environment and Forest launched the Vahini Scheme in June 1992, with the primary objective of encouraging people's participation in environmental protection. This scheme was designed to promote community development and environmental awareness. Under this scheme, financial assistance was provided to voluntary organizations. The goal was to run environmental education and awareness programs in rural and urban areas. Later, this scheme was merged into the National Environmental Awareness Campaign.

question_hi: पर्यावरण और वन मंत्रालय ने पर्यावरण संरक्षण में लोगों की भागीदारी को प्रोत्साहित करने के मूल उद्देश्य से वाहिनी योजना ______ में शुरू की थी। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)

question: Who among the following artists is NOT a painter? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Amrita Shergil
Nandalal Bose
Jamini Roy
Rukmini Devi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rukmini Devi

Explanation:
Rukmini Devi was a renowned classical dancer and choreographer, especially in Bharatanatyam. She played a vital role in reviving Indian arts and founded the Kalakshetra Foundation, but she was not a painter. In contrast, Amrita Sher-Gil was a pioneering painter, often called 'India's Frida Kahlo'. Nandalal Bose was a prominent painter and a disciple of Rabindranath Tagore, who modernized Indian miniature painting. Jamini Roy was a celebrated painter who drew inspiration from folk art, particularly Bengali motifs. Rukmini Devi's contribution lies in dance, not painting.

question_hi: निम्नलिखित कलाकारों में से कौन चित्रकार नहीं है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)

नंदलाल बोस
जमिनी रॉय
रुक्मिणी देवी
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है रुक्मिणी देवी

Explanation:
रुक्मिणी देवी एक प्रसिद्ध शास्त्रीय नृत्यांगना और कोरियोग्राफर थीं, विशेष रूप से भरतनाट्यम में। उन्होंने भारतीय कला को पुनर्जीवित करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई और कलाक्षेत्र फाउंडेशन की स्थापना की, लेकिन वे चित्रकार नहीं थीं। दूसरी ओर, अमृता शेरगिल एक प्रमुख चित्रकार थीं, जिन्हें 'भारत की फ्रीडा काहलो' कहा जाता है। नंदलाल बोस एक प्रसिद्ध चित्रकार और रवींद्रनाथ टैगोर के शिष्य थे, जिन्होंने भारतीय लघु चित्रकला को आधुनिक रूप दिया। जमिनी रॉय एक प्रसिद्ध चित्रकार थे, जिन्होंने लोक कला, विशेषकर बंगाली कलाकृतियों, से प्रेरणा ली। रुक्मिणी देवी का योगदान नृत्य में था, चित्रकला में नहीं।

question: To which of the following deities is the Dilwara Temple in Mount Abu dedicated? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Badrinath
Jagannath
Kedarnath
Adinath
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Adinath

Explanation:
The Dilwara Temple located in Mount Abu is a renowned Jain pilgrimage site. This temple is dedicated to Adinath (also known as Rishabhadeva), the first Tirthankara of Jainism. The Dilwara Temple complex consists of five temples, the most prominent being the Vimal Vasahi Temple (dedicated to Adinath), the Luna Vasahi Temple (dedicated to Neminath), and others. These temples are world-famous for their exquisite marble carvings and architectural brilliance. They were built between the 11th and 13th centuries. This site is located in the Sirohi district of Rajasthan. The Dilwara Temples hold significance for both the Digambara and Svetambara sects of Jainism.

☛ In which state is Dilwara Temple located? → Rajasthan
☛ Which stone is predominantly used in the construction of Dilwara Temple? → Marble
☛ To which Tirthankara is the Vimal Vasahi Temple dedicated? → Adinath
☛ In which district is Mount Abu situated? → Sirohi
question_hi: माउंट आबू में स्थित दिलवाड़ा मंदिर किस देवता को समर्पित है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)

जगन्नाथ
केदारनाथ
आदिनाथ
solution_hi:

Explanation:
माउंट आबू में स्थित दिलवाड़ा मंदिर जैन धर्म का एक प्रसिद्ध तीर्थ स्थल है। यह मंदिर जैन धर्म के प्रथम तीर्थंकर आदिनाथ (जिन्हें ऋषभदेव भी कहा जाता है) को समर्पित है। दिलवाड़ा मंदिर वास्तव में पाँच मंदिरों का एक समूह है, जिनमें प्रमुख हैं: विमल वसही मंदिर (आदिनाथ को समर्पित), लूना वसही मंदिर (नेमिनाथ को समर्पित), और अन्य। ये मंदिर अपनी अद्भुत संगमरमर की नक्काशी और स्थापत्य कला के लिए विश्व प्रसिद्ध हैं। इनका निर्माण 11वीं से 13वीं शताब्दी के बीच हुआ था। यह स्थल राजस्थान के सिरोही जिले में स्थित है। दिलवाड़ा मंदिर जैन धर्म के दिगंबर और श्वेतांबर दोनों संप्रदायों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।

question: The United Nations adopted the 'Charter of Economic Rights and Duties of States' in ______. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: December 1976
December 1977
December 1974
December 1980
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is December 1974

Explanation:
The United Nations General Assembly adopted the Charter of Economic Rights and Duties of States on 12 December 1974. This charter was drafted at the insistence of developing countries to establish fair rules in international economic relations. It includes principles such as the economic sovereignty of states, control over natural resources, and equitable trade. The charter is considered a part of the New International Economic Order (NIEO). It is notable that the UN General Assembly adopted it in 1974, while a related resolution on economic rights and duties was passed in 1976.

☛ Which body adopted this charter? → United Nations General Assembly
☛ Which economic order is this charter related to? → New International Economic Order (NIEO)
☛ What was the purpose of this charter? → To define the economic rights and duties of states
☛ Which charter includes full sovereignty over natural resources? → Charter of Economic Rights and Duties of States
question_hi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र ने 'राज्यों के आर्थिक अधिकारों और कर्तव्यों का चार्टर' ______ में अपनाया था। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)
options_hi: दिसंबर 1976
दिसंबर 1977
दिसंबर 1974
दिसंबर 1980
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है दिसंबर 1974

Explanation:
संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा ने 'राज्यों के आर्थिक अधिकारों और कर्तव्यों का चार्टर' (Charter of Economic Rights and Duties of States) को 12 दिसंबर 1974 को अपनाया। यह चार्टर विकासशील देशों के आग्रह पर बनाया गया था ताकि अंतरराष्ट्रीय आर्थिक संबंधों में न्यायसंगत नियम स्थापित हो सकें। इसमें राज्यों की आर्थिक संप्रभुता, प्राकृतिक संसाधनों पर नियंत्रण, और निष्पक्ष व्यापार जैसे सिद्धांत शामिल हैं। यह चार्टर न्यू इंटरनेशनल इकोनॉमिक ऑर्डर (NIEO) का एक हिस्सा माना जाता है। गौरतलब है कि संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा ने इसे 1974 में अपनाया था, जबकि 1976 में आर्थिक अधिकारों और कर्तव्यों पर एक और प्रस्ताव पारित हुआ था।

question: World Health Organization (WHO) gave its Tobacco Control Award for the year 2019 to the health department of the Indian state of ______. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Gujarat
Rajasthan
Punjab
Kerala
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rajasthan

Explanation:
The World Health Organization (WHO) awarded its Tobacco Control Award for the year 2019 to the health department of Rajasthan, India. This award recognizes outstanding contributions to tobacco control. Rajasthan was honored for its effective implementation of tobacco control laws under the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act (COTPA), including strict enforcement of smoking bans and promotion of tobacco-free cities. The state's awareness campaigns and policy measures significantly reduced tobacco use. This recognition highlights India's efforts in combating tobacco-related health issues. Rajasthan's success serves as a model for other states in tobacco control.

question: Which of the following places is known for the world's largest Camel Fairs in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/03/2021) Shift 1)
options: Pushkar
Jhalawar
Kolayat
Gangapur
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pushkar

Explanation:
Pushkar, located in Rajasthan, is famous for the world-renowned Pushkar Camel Fair. This fair is held around Kartik Purnima and attracts thousands of camels, horses, and other livestock for trading. It is one of the largest livestock fairs in India and draws tourists from around the world. Pushkar is also known for the Brahma Temple and Pushkar Lake. Other options: Jhalawar is known for its historical forts; Kolayat in Bikaner has a lake and fair, but the world record for the largest camel fair belongs to Pushkar. Gangapur is a small town.

question_hi: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा स्थान दुनिया के सबसे बड़े ऊंट मेले के लिए जाना जाता है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/03/2021) Shift 1)

झालावाड़
कोलायत
गंगापुर
solution_hi:

Explanation:

question: The subject 'Marriage' belongs to the: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/03/2021) Shift 1)
options: union list
residuary subjects
concurrent list
state list
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is concurrent list

Explanation:
The Concurrent List in the Indian Constitution includes subjects on which both the central and state governments can legislate. It includes Marriage, education, forests, labor welfare, etc. In case of a conflict between central and state laws, the central law prevails. The Concurrent List originally had 47 subjects, now increased to 52. Marriage falls under family law, which is part of this list. In contrast, the Union List contains subjects of national importance like defense and atomic energy, while the State List includes local matters like agriculture and police. Residuary subjects are those not mentioned in any list, e.g., computer software, and they fall under the central government's jurisdiction.

question: When did India adopt its Biological Diversity Act? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/03/2021) Shift 1)

2008
2005

Explanation:

Under this Act, the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) was established to oversee matters related to access to biological resources and benefit sharing. The Act was passed in 2002 and came into force in 2003. It plays a crucial role in regulating the use of India's rich biodiversity and ensuring that local communities benefit from the commercial use of biological resources.

question: What is the full form of GEO? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Geography Earth Orbit
Geostructure Element Orbit
Geographical Earth Orbit
Geostationary Earth Orbit
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Geostationary Earth Orbit

Explanation:
The full form of GEO is Geostationary Earth Orbit. It is a circular orbit located approximately 35,786 kilometers above the Earth's equator. Satellites in this orbit travel at the same rotational speed as the Earth, making them appear stationary relative to a fixed point on the ground. This unique property makes GEO ideal for communication satellites, weather satellites, and broadcasting services. Other options like Geography Earth Orbit or Geostructure Element Orbit are incorrect as GEO specifically refers to a geostationary orbit, which is a type of geosynchronous orbit. GEO is widely used in satellite telecommunications because it allows continuous coverage of a specific region.

question: An additional margin added to a page layout to compensate for the part of the paper made unusable by the binding process is called: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/03/2021) Shift 2)
